verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO respondeu Jó, dizendo:

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְאֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî ḵə·’êl·leh rab·bō·wṯ mə·na·ḥă·mê ‘ā·māl kul·lə·ḵem
verses.literal: I have heard many things like these miserable comforters are you all
verses.literalPt: Tenho ouvido muitas coisas como estas; todos vós sois consoladores molestos.

verses.original: הֲקֵ֥ץ לְדִבְרֵי־ ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה־ יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·qêṣ lə·ḏiḇ·rê- rū·aḥ ’ōw mah- yam·rî·ṣə·ḵā kî ṯa·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: Is there no end to your long-winded . . . speeches What provokes you to continue testifying
verses.literalPt: Porventura não terão fim essas palavras de vento? Ou o que te irrita, para assim responderes?

verses.original: גַּ֤ם׀ אָנֹכִי֮ כָּכֶ֪ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ־ יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בְּמִלִּ֑ים וְאָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: gam ’ā·nō·ḵî kā·ḵem ’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh lū- yêš nap̄·šə·ḵem ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šî ’aḥ·bî·rāh ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·mil·lîm wə·’ā·nî·‘āh ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·mōw rō·šî
verses.literal: I could also speak like you if you were in my place I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you . . .
verses.literalPt: Falaria eu também como vós falais, se a vossa alma estivesse em lugar da minha alma, ou amontoaria palavras contra vós, e menearia contra vós a minha cabeça?

verses.original: אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ־ פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·’am·miṣ·ḵem bə·mōw- p̄î wə·nîḏ śə·p̄ā·ṯay yaḥ·śōḵ
verses.literal: But I would encourage you with my mouth and the consolation of my lips would bring relief
verses.literalPt: Antes vos fortaleceria com a minha boca, e a consolação dos meus lábios abrandaria a vossa dor.

verses.original: אִֽם־ אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא־ יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑י וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה־ מִנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh lō- yê·ḥā·śêḵ kə·’ê·ḇî wə·’aḥ·də·lāh mah- min·nî ya·hă·lōḵ
verses.literal: Even if I speak my pain is not relieved and if I hold back how will it go away
verses.literalPt: Se eu falar, a minha dor não cessa, e, calando-me eu, qual é o meu alívio?

verses.original: אַךְ־ עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל־ עֲדָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ‘at·tāh hel·’ā·nî hă·šim·mō·w·ṯā kāl- ‘ă·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: Surely He has now exhausted me You have devastated all my family
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, agora tu me tens fatigado; tu assolaste toda a minha companhia,

verses.original: וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַיָּ֥קָם בִּ֥י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י בְּפָנַ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·mə·ṭê·nî lə·‘êḏ hā·yāh way·yā·qām bî ḵa·ḥă·šî bə·p̄ā·nay ya·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: You have bound me and it has become a witness my frailty rises up and testifies against me
verses.literalPt: Testemunha disto é que já me fizeste enrugado, e a minha magreza já se levanta contra mim, e no meu rosto testifica contra mim.

verses.original: אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף׀ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣י בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו צָרִ֓י׀ יִלְט֖וֹשׁ עֵינָ֣יו לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap·pōw ṭā·rap̄ way·yiś·ṭə·mê·nî ḥā·raq ‘ā·lay bə·šin·nāw ṣā·rî yil·ṭō·wōš ‘ê·nāw lî
verses.literal: His anger has torn me and opposed me He gnashes His teeth at me My adversary pierces me with His eyes
verses.literalPt: Na sua ira me despedaçou, e ele me perseguiu; rangeu os seus dentes contra mim; aguça o meu adversário os seus olhos contra mim.

verses.original: פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨י׀ בְּפִיהֶ֗ם בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: pā·‘ă·rū ‘ā·lay bə·p̄î·hem bə·ḥer·pāh hik·kū lə·ḥā·yāy ya·ḥaḏ ‘ā·lay yiṯ·mal·lā·’ūn
verses.literal: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt they join together against me
verses.literalPt: Abrem a sua boca contra mim; com desprezo me feriram nos queixos, e contra mim se ajuntam todos.

verses.original: יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְעַל־ יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yas·gî·rê·nî ’êl ’el ‘ă·wîl wə·‘al- yə·ḏê rə·šā·‘îm yir·ṭê·nî
verses.literal: God has delivered me to unjust men He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Entrega-me Deus ao perverso, e nas mãos dos ímpios me faz cair.

verses.original: שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי׀ וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lêw hā·yî·ṯî way·p̄ar·pə·rê·nî wə·’ā·ḥaz bə·‘ā·rə·pî way·p̄aṣ·pə·ṣê·nî way·qî·mê·nî lōw lə·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: I was at ease but He shattered me He seized me by the neck and crushed me He has set me up as His target
verses.literalPt: Descansado estava eu, porém ele me quebrantou; e pegou-me pela cerviz, e me despedaçou; também me pôs por seu alvo.

verses.original: יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י׀ רַבָּ֗יו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִי׃
verses.transliteration: yā·sōb·bū ‘ā·lay rab·bāw yə·p̄al·laḥ kil·yō·w·ṯay wə·lō yaḥ·mō·wl yiš·pōḵ lā·’ā·reṣ mə·rê·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: His archers surround me . . . He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground
verses.literalPt: Cercam-me os seus flecheiros; atravessa-me os rins, e não me poupa, e o meu fel derrama sobre a terra,

verses.original: יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·rə·ṣê·nî p̄e·reṣ ‘al- pə·nê- p̄ā·reṣ yā·ruṣ ‘ā·lay kə·ḡib·bō·wr
verses.literal: He breaks me with wound upon wound He rushes me like a mighty warrior
verses.literalPt: Fere-me com ferimento sobre ferimento; arremete contra mim como um valente.

verses.original: שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶעָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: śaq tā·p̄ar·tî ‘ă·lê ḡil·dî wə·‘ō·lal·tî ḇe·‘ā·p̄ār qar·nî
verses.literal: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin I have buried my horn in the dust
verses.literalPt: Cosi sobre a minha pele o cilício, e revolvi a minha cabeça no pó.

verses.original: פָּנַ֣י חֳמַרְמְרָה מִנִּי־ בֶ֑כִי וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: pā·nay ḥo·mar·mə·rå̄h min·nî- ḇe·ḵî wə·‘al ‘ap̄·‘ap·pay ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: My face is red with weeping and deep shadows ring my eyes
verses.literalPt: O meu rosto está todo avermelhado de chorar, e sobre as minhas pálpebras está a sombra da morte:

verses.original: עַ֭ל לֹא־ חָמָ֣ס בְּכַפָּ֑י וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al lō- ḥā·mās bə·ḵap·pāy ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî zak·kāh
verses.literal: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure
verses.literalPt: Apesar de não haver violência nas minhas mãos, e de ser pura a minha oração.

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל־ תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י וְֽאַל־ יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ ’al- tə·ḵas·sî ḏā·mî wə·’al- yə·hî mā·qō·wm lə·za·‘ă·qā·ṯî
verses.literal: O earth do not cover my blood may my cry for help never be laid to rest
verses.literalPt: Ah! terra, não cubras o meu sangue e não haja lugar para ocultar o meu clamor!

verses.original: גַּם־ עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה־ בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑י וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ‘at·tāh hin·nêh- ḇaš·šā·ma·yim ‘ê·ḏî wə·śā·hă·ḏî bam·mə·rō·w·mîm
verses.literal: Even now . . . my witness is in heaven and my advocate is on high
verses.literalPt: Eis que também agora a minha testemunha está no céu, e nas alturas o meu testemunho está.

verses.original: מְלִיצַ֥י רֵעָ֑י אֶל־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mə·lî·ṣay rê·‘āy ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ha dā·lə·p̄āh ‘ê·nî
verses.literal: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God
verses.literalPt: Os meus amigos são os que zombam de mim; os meus olhos se desfazem em lágrimas diante de Deus.

verses.original: וְיוֹכַ֣ח לְגֶ֣בֶר עִם־ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן־ אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·ḵaḥ lə·ḡe·ḇer ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ū·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām lə·rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads . . . with his neighbor
verses.literalPt: Ah! se alguém pudesse contender com Deus pelo homem, como o homem pelo seu próximo!

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא־ אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šə·nō·wṯ mis·pār ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yū wə·’ō·raḥ lō- ’ā·šūḇ ’e·hĕ·lōḵ
verses.literal: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return
verses.literalPt: Porque decorridos poucos anos, eu seguirei o caminho por onde não tornarei.
